lobbying.method: In-year nowcast: the amount filed so far this year (through the latest complete quarter) plus the share still to come of the prior full year, where the filed share is the geometric mean of the share filed by that quarter in up to the three prior years (Melange LDA, nominal dollars). Later years carry it forward unchanged unless a growth-forecast change is entered, which moves it by the pooled log slope.
